Visually, the left eye is a flat, dark void without a pupil or specular highlight, unlike the right eye which has some definition. This confirms the Router's severity of 2.5. I would argue this is closer to 3.0 as it represents a failure in basic anatomical rendering (eye sphere/pupil).
